description: T-1777 SPEC-0011 open question 11, the cheap forms: a stacked result one row or column past the grid with few cells. W1-W2 VSTACK(A:A,B1:B2) is 1048578 x 1; W3-W4 HSTACK(A1:XFD1,A1:A2) is 2 x 16385; W7 and W8 add one cell past the grid; W9 the explicit form; W5, W6 and W10 are in-grid controls. The 2^34-cell forms are in -c2 and -c3.
